tasks.description: The login flow should be defined to ensure a seamless user experience. This includes determining the authentication method and user session management. The definition should be detailed enough to guide the implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid username and password, when the user attempts to log in, then they are redirected to the dashboard.

tasks.description: The types of reports that will be available in the customer portal need to be identified. This includes determining the data sources for each report and the frequency of report generation.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of available reports, when the user navigates to the reports section, then they can view the list of reports.

tasks.description: The notification settings for the customer portal should be defined. This includes determining the types of notifications, notification channels, and user preferences for notifications.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user's notification preferences, when an event occurs, then the user receives a notification according to their preferences.

tasks.description: The background section of the customer portal document should be written to provide context and history. This includes researching and gathering relevant information about the project.
acceptance_criteria: Given the background section, when it is reviewed, then it provides a clear understanding of the project's context and history.

tasks.description: The acceptance criteria for the customer portal should be defined to ensure that the project meets the required standards. This includes identifying the key performance indicators and success metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Given the acceptance criteria, when the project is reviewed, then it meets the defined standards.
